params.1273: Grind some flour in Lumbridge's mill.
params.1274: Follow the road north out of Lumbridge.
params.1275: Go past the general store and Fred's farm, until you reach a junction with a wheat field.
params.1276: Enter the windmill to the north.
params.1277: Climb the ladders to the very top of the windmill and put some wheat into the hopper.
params.1278: Operate the hopper controls to grind the wheat and climb back down to remove your flour from the bin below.
params.1292: This Beginner Task is part of the Lumbridge set.
